method: Paper only. Each model sees the same Hyperliquid data every 15 minutes and must answer LONG or SHORT (no standing aside) with its confidence and one invalidation level. A call stays open while the direction is unchanged; it closes on a flip, when a 1-minute bar reaches its profit target (a win), or when one touches its invalidation level (a loss; if one bar touches both, the loss is booked). Result at leverage L: a move of 1/L against the position at any time is a total loss of that position; otherwise L times the price change. Fees, funding and slippage are not modelled. Rows marked "selective" are a test of a second prompt on the same model: asked once an hour, allowed to stand aside (FLAT), told to name what points to the next move rather than follow the last one. They started later and are not counted in the headline call.
